contracts: (S37 verifies that every exercised stale-input case receives a non-success verdict.) AND (S37 verifies that reused matrix evidence produces an invalid aggregate result and blocks acceptance.) AND (The aggregate-evaluation selector observes an invalid aggregate and no acceptance eligibility for an infrastructure-failed Matrix Case.)

Each declared assertion needs a cer_assertion mapping and a meaningful independent oracle. Tests must invoke the real production entry. The plan is not a behavior observation. Keep governance/constraint failures non-authorizing; do not emit expected-red for them. Preserve all bound Given/When/Then and forbidden outcomes. No placeholder pass or synthetic RED.

selector_intents: Run the aggregate-evaluation selector with an infrastructure-failed Matrix Case; retaining a valid or accepted aggregate must fail.
S37 must fail if a stale-input case receives a successful verdict.
S37 must fail when reused matrix evidence leaves an aggregate valid or permits its acceptance.
